text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it started coverage of Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp on Friday with a long-term buy and a near-term neutral rating.

-- Analyst Michael Frenquilli cited stock's "parentage" and its strong balance sheet. "By parentage I mean the Travelers Group and (chairman) Sandy Weill. He has a record as a 'streamlining artist' ... and the balance sheet is a strong one because both the old Travelers and Aetna strengthened reserves massively, by about $2 billion over the past few years ," Frenquilli said.
-- "Ultimately, the industry needs consolidating and they appear to be in a good position to do that," he said.
-- Travelers/Aetna shares closed at 51 on Thursday.
